usedFor: Podio holds app items, and Google Sheets receives them when “New Item Created” runs “Add Multiple Rows”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Item Created” in Podio, then “Add Multiple Rows” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Each new Podio item lands in a sheet row, giving you a running list outside Podio.

watchOut: “New Item Created” in Podio is polling, so “Add Multiple Rows” writes after a scheduled check, not at once.
